lines.text: How have things been since last time?
Since last time the pain's spread into my left buttock, if I'm remembering right.
Actually, I also wanted to ask about my sleep, I'm only getting about four hours a night.
No doubt about it, there's tingling in my big toe most days.
Let me have a look. Lifting your left leg straight brings on the buttock pain at about 50 degrees.
The muscles on the left side of your back are pretty tight.
It might be a nerve being irritated at the bottom of the spine, though I'm fairly confident it's nothing serious.
Lie on your back, bring both knees to your chest and rock gently side to side for a minute, morning and night.
If you lose feeling between your legs or can't pass water, go straight to A and E.
I'm sure that won't happen, but I'll keep an eye on it.
Good. Let's see you next week.
